messages:
jordan: Hey support — signed up earlier today, verified my email, completed Apple Pay quick-checkout, but free trial credits didn't show up. account acc_9b3f, email jordan+prod@gmail.com. Anyone able to check?

maya: Hey! Sorry about that. Can you paste the exact signup timestamp and the payment token/id so we can look in payments logs?

jordan: signup_ts 1787654200, payment_token tok_apple_9X, payment_method=applepay, UA=Safari iOS 16.4

payments-bot: [automated] payment_event: token=tok_apple_9X status=verified risk_score=0.78 region=EU country=IE duplicate_account_flag=true

maya: Payments shows verification passed but duplicate_account_flag=true — that will block the auto-grant. @sam can you confirm what triggers that?

sam: Confirmed. duplicate_account_flag is set when phone/email/SSO overlap or heuristics find an existing account. I can see an older acc_2a1 with phone +353871234567 linked to jordan@gmail.com. New signup used jordan+prod@gmail.com and same phone via carrier lookup, plus GitHub SSO. That bumped risk to medium and disabled auto_grant.

sam: Quick repro/query for engs: GET /admin/accounts/acc_9b3f -> check flags: "auto_grant": false, "review_reason": "duplicate_phone". Check payments/events?token=tok_apple_9X for the risk details.

lila: We can do a manual grant once identity is verified. Maya — do we have ok to proceed? What verification did they provide?

maya: Jordan — can you confirm you control both the old and new emails or provide a public SSO handle? We need a quick identity check before manual override.

jordan: I control both. Old email is jordan@gmail.com, new is jordan+prod@gmail.com (same owner). I used GitHub SSO on the new signup — handle is @jordan_dev. Apple Pay is on my phone so can't give card last4. Happy to confirm via GitHub.

lila: Thanks — verified GitHub handle matches our OAuth logs for the signup. Proceeding with manual grant.

lila: Running admin grant: POST /admin/grants {"account_id":"acc_9b3f","type":"signup_trial","amount_credits":100,"grant_note":"manual override duplicate_account_verified"} -> 200 OK

lila: Credits applied. Please refresh and confirm you see the 100 trial credits.

jordan: I see 100 credits now, thanks so much :raised_hands: this fixed my onboarding flow.

maya: Great — closing the loop. I'll add a short KB item: "Apple Pay quick-checkout + duplicate-phone/email can set duplicate_account_flag -> blocks auto-grant. Support flow: verify identity (SSO handle or email control), check GET /admin/accounts for flags, then POST /admin/grants for manual override."

sam: Filing a follow-up with payments infra to evaluate lowering the auto-grant block for low-risk duplicate-phone in EU regions (ticket PAY-4381).

jordan: Appreciate the fast help :white_check_mark:
